metadata.question: Was the PM2.5 higher over Wuhan, China in February 2020 than in February 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search Strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI data for PM2.5 measurements - Collection: 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI' (Aerosol Index) or 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_LH' (Aerosol Layer Height) - Actually, for PM2.5 specifically, we should use the COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI collection which provides aerosol data - Date ranges: February 1-28, 2019 vs February 1-29, 2020 - Location: Wuhan, China (approx coordinates: 114.3055°E, 30.5928°N) 2. Masking Strategy: - Need to mask clouds and poor quality data - Use the 'qa_value' band for quality filtering 3. Logic: - Calculate mean PM2.5 proxy (aerosol index) for each period - Compare 2020 vs 2019 - Handle cases where no data exists or all pixels are masked - Use aerosol index as proxy for PM2.5 levels Let me structure the code to: 1. Define Wuhan geometry 2. Get Sentinel-5P aerosol data for both periods 3. Check collection sizes 4. Calculate mean aerosol index for each period 5. Compare and provide answer ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var wuhan = ee.Geometry.Point([114.3055, 30.5928]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer around Wuhan var feb2019 = ee.DateRange('2019-02-01', '2019-02-28'); var feb2020 = ee.DateRange('2020-02-01', '2020-02-29'); // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-5P Aerosol Index var col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI') .filterDate(feb2019) .filterBounds(wuhan); var col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI') .filterDate(feb2020) .filterBounds(wuhan); // Check collection sizes var size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); var size2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}, 2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2019 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Get mean aerosol index (proxy for PM2.5) var mean2019 = col2019.mean().select('absorbing_aerosol_index'); var mean2020 = col2020.mean().select('absorbing_aerosol_index'); // Count valid pixels var count2019 = mean2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: wuhan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('absorbing_aerosol_index').getInfo(); var count2020 = mean2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: wuhan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('absorbing_aerosol_index').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels 2019: ${count2019}, 2020: ${count2020}`); if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean values var val2019 = mean2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: wuhan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('absorbing_aerosol_index').getInfo(); var val2020 = mean2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: wuhan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('absorbing_aerosol_index').getInfo(); console.log(`Mean Aerosol Index 2019: ${val2019?.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`Mean Aerosol Index 2020: ${val2020?.toFixed(3)}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (val2019 === null || val2020 === null || isNaN(val2019) || isNaN(val2020)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (val2020 > val2019) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
